desc: FINAL STATIC RESULT: OPEN / R3 NO-GO. PAC-aware 25F84 decode found the actual processModeFlags detach branches, software-only USB2/USB3 object removal, HPM inactive/active mask reconstruction, and framework-managed semantic eUSB2/ACIO shutdown. It still found no VBUS-off operation, race-safe inverse for the 0x14 OR mutation plus W1C/cache state, exact mask/detect restoration, restoration of observed pre-SSPS state 0x07, preserving 0x23 inverse/neutral 0x55, or safe cross-layer teardown order. Do not build/run 102-108 without new primary evidence. Evidence: done/2026-07-24-t6040-hpm2-detach-static-slice.md. RISK CALIBRATION 2026-07-25: the earlier framing implying an unrecoverable/permanently-damaged port is WITHDRAWN. No persistent-brick mechanism exists in the staged op set (no flash/OTP/patch-bundle writes; runtime register RMW + 4CC only), SN201202x state is volatile and re-initialized by AppleHPM each boot, and the right port holds only the passive stick (M1 cable is on the DFU port). Worst realistic case is odd port state until a power cycle, which is free in a workflow that power-cycles every chainload. R3 therefore remains gated NOT for safety but because the FORWARD sequence is incomplete (0x14 semantics, raw masks, cached-command/interrupt/power-config/repeater coordination unresolved), so success probability is low. See done/2026-07-25-t6040-r3-risk-calibration.md.
